question: Can MV-HGS-SP itself (not plain HGS) reproduce the new BKS found by warm-started plain PyVRP HGS?
method: MV-HGS-SP = HGS + cross-run route pool + time-limited set partitioning. Warm-started at the frozen 2013 BKS solution, 3 epochs x 12,000 iterations each, pool assembly after each epoch, min(incumbent, MILP) safeguard.
interpretation: MV-HGS-SP matched plain HGS's warm-start result bit-for-bit on both tested instances. This confirms the theoretical floor (pool assembly cannot be worse than its best input, since the incumbent's own routes are always in the pool) but does NOT demonstrate MV-HGS-SP exceeding plain HGS on these two points. Attribution of the 18 new BKS to MV-HGS-SP is honest only if stated as 'reproduced via the same warm-start protocol', not as 'MV-HGS-SP found something HGS could not'.
sample_size_caveat: n=2 instances only (largest and mid-size wins). Not yet extended to all 18. Before claiming general reproduction, the remaining 16 should be spot-checked or the claim scoped to 'verified on 2/18, theoretically guaranteed not to underperform on the rest by the min() safeguard'.
not_authorised: claiming MV-HGS-SP exceeds plain HGS based on this data
extending to all 18 without further runs
